subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should OpenClaw publish a generic upstream-activity Plugin SDK contract now, and if so must provider identity and classification remain fully plugin-owned?
rationale: The patch changes a public Plugin SDK surface and persistent session model; code review can identify defects but cannot choose the permanent extension contract or accept the no-backfill upgrade behavior.

options.title: Approve a corrected generic seam
options.body: Keep the feature after making source identity opaque and plugin-owned, carrying agent-qualified result identity, scoping dedupe in core, and proving upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep observers private for now
options.body: Remove the public SDK additions and retain provider-specific implementation internally until the canonical SessionObserver direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve a corrected generic seam
recommendation.body: Keep the feature after making source identity opaque and plugin-owned, carrying agent-qualified result identity, scoping dedupe in core, and proving upgrade behavior.
